overall: No violation found. The Board recessed rather than adjourned, and its later unanticipated move back to its original room was permissible. The AG noted a missed door sign and cautioned against long recesses, but ordered nothing.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged that on July 11 the Board held an unnoticed meeting after adjourning a noticed meeting, when it moved back to its original room.
allegations.key_passage: We find that the Board had recessed, rather than adjourned, its meeting, with the intention of reconvening at 7 PM in the room where the Nyanza Advisory Committee was meeting, as indicated on the meeting notice.
